hypothesis: 2-3 predicted next questions with answers shown with a resumed card cut the lookup effort at the start of the next segment.
unit: A segment where a pack showed or held a card that has stored next questions; assignment is per segment, so every metric is aggregated per segment first.

metric.primary: next_lookup_calls: juno search calls plus vault Reads in the first 10 tool calls of the unit (lower is better).
secondary: prediction hit rate: fold-token Jaccard of at least 0.5 between a question and one of the first 3 typed prompts, measurable in both arms because both store the questions

stop_rule: Decide at min_n units per arm or at max_days; no early stop.
decision: On only if the primary metric falls by at least 1 call per unit (bootstrap 90% upper bound of on minus off below 0) and card cost per run rises by at most $0.02. Otherwise off, and the stored questions stay unused.
caveat: Evidence is synthetic only and the primary metric is the weakest proxy of the three arms. Not started: it is the only arm that raises the card-run cost on every run.
